description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams used for filtering search results of comments related to a specific 'share' in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes a shareId property with getter and setter, as well as a default sort field.

classes.name: BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for filtering search results of buzz comments by share ID, with preset sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'comment.createdAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the current share ID being used for filtering.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the share ID used as a filter criterion.
